info.title: Thapsus-HR API
info.description: Versioned public REST API. All responses are served from the tenant's home region and are never cached at the edge.

bearer.description: Scoped API key (thr_sk_…) or OAuth 2.0 access token (thr_at_…). See docs/api.md.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials (RFC 6749 §4.4). Effective permissions = the client role ∩ the granted scopes.

scopes.employees:write: Allows: employees.read, employees.history, employees.create, employees.update, employees.terminate
scopes.leave:write: Allows: leave.read, absence.read, leave.record, leave.manage, leave.adjust, absence.record
scopes.time:write: Allows: time.read, rota.view, rota.manage, time.manage, time.correct, time.approve

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

get.summary: Begin SSO sign-in (redirects to the identity provider)

post.summary: Create a workspace in this region (the caller has already chosen the home region)

get.summary: List or export the audit log (JSON page or full CSV/JSON download for a date range)
List employees the caller may see (cursor-paginated, permission-filtered)

post.summary: Hire (create) an employee with effective-dated personal, job, pay and contract records
Apply an effective-dated change (past, today or future-dated)

regions.description: Subdivisions the answering version was verified for (e.g. GB-ENG, GB-WLS, GB-SCT); absent = the whole jurisdiction
Subdivisions the answering version was verified for (e.g. GB-ENG, GB-WLS, GB-SCT); absent = the whole jurisdiction

post.summary: Creates draft shifts for a week from a template (open, or assigned where the slot names an employee)
Creates a draft shift from local wall-clock times in an IANA zone (end ≤ start = overnight). Working-time findings are returned as warnings, or refused with 422 when the tenant blocks.

get.summary: Shifts in a date range (keyset-paginated by date, start, id), permission-filtered
Rota grid for one week: employees (keyset by name, id) with their shifts, plus open shifts on the first page

post.summary: Publishes draft shifts in a range and notifies each affected employee once (in-app, email and web push)

get.summary: Published open shifts the caller may claim (same location/department where the shift names one)

post.summary: Asks to take a published open shift; the manager approves (working time re-checked on approval)
Offers my published shift to a colleague (optionally in exchange for theirs); the colleague accepts, then the manager approves

get.summary: Time and rota settings (readable by every signed-in user, e.g. for the geofence notice)

post.summary: Batch sync of clock events from the offline queue; idempotent per clientEventId. Coordinates are discarded unless geofencing applies.

get.summary: Clock events for an employee (never includes coordinates)

post.summary: Manager correction: a new clock event (source manager, with reason) that may supersede an earlier one; audited
Registers a shared kiosk device. The token is returned once; only its hash is stored.

put.summary: Sets an employee kiosk PIN (stored as an Argon2id hash)

get.summary: Kiosk device check (Authorization: Kiosk <token>)

post.summary: Shared kiosk clock in/out: employee number + PIN. Rate-limited; locks after repeated failures; identical errors for unknown numbers and wrong PINs.

get.summary: Weekly timesheet: recorded vs rota per day (variances flagged), overtime and working-time findings from the jurisdiction packs

post.summary: Submits a week for approval (snapshot frozen until decided)

get.summary: Timesheets for a week in the caller’s scope (keyset by name, id)
Payroll export feed: CSV of approved timesheets for a week (reproducible; every export is audited)

post.summary: Records a written opt-out from the 48-hour average week (only where the jurisdiction pack permits one, e.g. GB)
Ends an opt-out: the worker (or HR) gives notice; it ends when the notice period expires

get.summary: Compliance reminder and reporting settings (product settings; statutory values come from the jurisdiction packs)
Probation end dates and the date unfair dismissal protection begins (qualifying period effective-dated from the packs)
Compliance status overview for the caller's scope on a date
UK right-to-work check methods, document lists, follow-up and retention rules from the GB pack
Right-to-work status of UK employees (current and within the retention period)

post.summary: Record a right-to-work check; the follow-up date is calculated from the GB pack
Upload the copy of the documents or the online check result (stored in the vault)

get.summary: One check with its vault details (every decrypt is audited)
Form I-9 status of US employees (deadlines, reverification and retention from the US pack)

post.summary: Create or update the Form I-9 record for an employment (deadlines from the US pack)

patch.summary: Record Section 1/2 completion, a new authorization expiry or a completed reverification (Supplement B)

post.summary: Upload the completed Form I-9 or document copies (stored in the vault)
Record a licence, certificate, background check or training completion for an employee

get.summary: Status per employee and applicable requirement (compliant / expiring / expired / missing), permission-scoped, with filters

put.summary: Record the sex used for statutory pay-gap reporting (vault, diversity)

post.summary: Voluntary self-identification (race/ethnicity, sex, veteran and disability status) — stored only in the vault

get.summary: Read one self-identification (vault.read:eeo; the view is audited)
EEO-1 Component 1 data: counts by job category, race/ethnicity and sex for a workforce snapshot date, with small-cell suppression

put.summary: Load per-employee pay data for a reporting snapshot (UK gender pay gap or EU pay transparency); replaces rows for the same snapshot

get.summary: UK gender pay gap figures (S.I. 2017/172) for a snapshot year and sector, from loaded pay data or current pay records
EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970 indicators per EU legal entity, with the member state's transposition status
Exempt / non-exempt check for US employees (salary level incl. state thresholds, salary basis, duties attestation) and resulting overtime eligibility
Whether an employee is overtime-eligible on a date (for the time and payroll modules)

post.summary: Attest the duties test for an exempt employee (effective-dated; closes the previous attestation)
Holiday accrued in a pay period by an irregular-hours or part-year worker (WTR reg. 15B)

get.summary: GB irregular-hours / part-year workers and whether their leave policy accrues per hour worked at the statutory percentage
Statutory Sick Pay position of GB employees with sickness in the last year (from /v1/sickness/{employeeId}/statutory-pay)
Statutory leave rules that apply where the tenant employs people (US state/local paid sick leave and FMLA; EU baseline and member-state leave, sick pay and notice)

post.summary: Add a law-changes feed entry

patch.summary: Correct, publish or withdraw an entry (every change is in the staff audit trail)

get.summary: Law changes relevant to the jurisdictions where the company has entities, locations or employees, with read and acknowledged state

post.summary: Acknowledge an entry (audited)

get.summary: Published self-serve plans, bands and prices (integer minor units, excluding tax) from the billing configuration

put.summary: Company billing details and billing contacts (failed-payment emails go to every contact)

post.summary: Price and change preview for the current headcount (nothing is changed)
Choose a self-serve plan, term and currency (keeps any trial days left)
Upgrade (now, prorated) or downgrade (end of the paid period)
Cancel with notice: ends at the first period end after the notice period
Withdraw a cancellation before it takes effect
Start a hosted page to add a card (card details never reach Thapsus-HR)
Stripe webhook (signature verified, idempotent per event id; events for other regions are ignored)

get.summary: Help centre articles: search (q), contextual (context = app path) or all

post.summary: Raise a support ticket (stored in the home region; SLA targets from the plan)

get.summary: This region's service status: components, active incidents, maintenance and recent history

post.summary: Post an incident or scheduled maintenance for this cell's region (shown on the public status page)

get.summary: This cell's customers with usage aggregates (counts and bytes only)
Every region, from the global tenant directory only (ids, slugs, regions, plan, status; no personal data)
Customer detail: company name, usage, billing structure (no billing contacts), contracts, and whether this staff member holds a support grant

post.summary: Group legal entities into a separately invoiced billing account (multi-entity billing)

patch.summary: Change a billing account: entities, currency, invoicing, payment terms, purchase order number

post.summary: Record an enterprise contract (draft): custom pricing overrides, annual invoicing, payment terms, renewal dates

patch.summary: Edit a draft contract, or the dates, renewal and notes of an active one

post.summary: Activate: replaces self-serve billing with one contract subscription per billing account (invoice collection with payment terms; PO numbers on invoices)

get.summary: This cell's support queue with SLA flags (metadata only; open a ticket to read it)
Read a ticket the customer submitted to support (audited in the customer log and the staff trail)

patch.summary: Change priority (SLA deadlines are recalculated from the opening time) or status

post.summary: Reply to the customer (first reply stops the first-response timer)

get.summary: Support grants customers have given this staff member (active and past)
View an employee record to debug an issue: requires an active support grant from the customer; audited in both logs

patch.summary: Correct an employee's work contact details: requires a read-and-write support grant; audited in both logs

get.summary: Staff audit trail (super admins). format=csv exports it; every export is itself recorded.

put.summary: Override this region's contact channels per plan (newest version wins; history kept)

post.summary: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint (client credentials grant, RFC 6749 §4.4)
post.description: Send application/x-www-form-urlencoded with grant_type=client_credentials and an optional space-delimited scope. Authenticate with HTTP Basic (client_id:client_secret).

get.summary: List API keys (cursor-paginated, newest first)

prefix.description: Shown as thr_sk_…<prefix> to identify the key

post.summary: Create a scoped API key (the key is returned once and never again)

prefix.description: Shown as thr_sk_…<prefix> to identify the key

key.description: thr_sk_… — store it now; it cannot be shown again

post.summary: Revoke an API key immediately

prefix.description: Shown as thr_sk_…<prefix> to identify the key

get.summary: List OAuth 2.0 clients (cursor-paginated, newest first)

post.summary: Create an OAuth 2.0 client for the client credentials grant (the secret is returned once)
Issue a new client secret; the previous one keeps working for graceHours (0 = revoke now)
Revoke a client and every access token it holds

get.summary: Roles that can be attached to an API credential
Event types an endpoint can subscribe to
List webhook endpoints

secrets.description: Signing secrets (values are never shown again). Two are active during a rotation.

post.summary: Create a webhook endpoint (https only); the signing secret is returned once

secrets.description: Signing secrets (values are never shown again). Two are active during a rotation.

secret.description: whsec_… — store it now; it cannot be shown again

patch.summary: Update an endpoint (URL, event types, description, or disable/enable it)

secrets.description: Signing secrets (values are never shown again). Two are active during a rotation.

delete.summary: Delete an endpoint and its delivery log

post.summary: Rotate the signing secret; the old secret keeps signing (a second v1) for graceHours

secrets.description: Signing secrets (values are never shown again). Two are active during a rotation.

post.summary: Send a signed webhook.ping event to this endpoint

get.summary: Delivery log for an endpoint (newest first, cursor-paginated)
One delivery with every attempt (status code, duration, error class) and the signed payload

post.summary: Replay a delivery (same event id and payload, new signature); receivers de-duplicate on Thapsus-Event-Id

get.summary: List SIEM audit streams

post.summary: Stream the audit log to a SIEM: a signed HTTPS endpoint, or an S3 bucket in your home region via a cross-account role

startFrom.description: Stream only new events (default) or back-fill the whole sealed log

anyOf.description: HTTPS streams: whsec_… signing secret, shown once

patch.summary: Rename, re-filter, pause or resume a stream

delete.summary: Delete a stream and its delivery log

post.summary: Deliver pending audit events now instead of waiting for the next sweep

get.summary: Delivery log for a stream (newest first)
Sandboxes created from this workspace

post.summary: Create a sandbox from this workspace’s configuration with synthetic people (no personal data is copied)
One-time sign-in link (15 minutes) for the sandbox’s synthetic owner account

get.summary: Feature flags and branding for the signed-in workspace (the app hides disabled features)
Feature flags for this workspace

put.summary: Turn a company-managed feature on or off (null restores the default)

get.summary: Custom branding (accent colour and logo)

put.summary: Set the brand accent; refused (422 with the failing contrast pairs) unless WCAG 2.2 AA holds in light and dark mode

post.summary: Upload a logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP; stored in the home-region bucket)

get.summary: The workspace logo image (signed-in users)

put.summary: Set any feature flag for a tenant (including staff-managed ones)
Override the tenant’s public API rate limit (null restores the plan default)

post.summary: Request a move of the tenant to another configured database (run by the move runner, status-tracked)

get.summary: Status and progress of a move request

post.summary: Cancel a move that has not started

servers.description: Your workspace home region (uk, eu or us). Responses are never cached at the edge.
